request_summary: Add a --show-rank1-misses diagnostic to the eval runner so the positive prompts that rank outside first place are visible instead of being silently counted, since the runner currently only prints a prompt that falls out of the top-K entirely.
rationale: C0: 1 edit-target files in one package, no one-way door (1 edit-target files / 0 package(s) (root pseudo-package excluded, Q1 2026-08-21) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=brownfield)
entry_point: `node scripts/run-evals.js --min-rank1 95` (the ranking gate in npm test and CI)
done_oracle: `node scripts/run-evals.js --min-rank1 95 --show-rank1-misses` prints, for each positive prompt whose skill did not rank first, the prompt, its actual rank and the skill that outranked it; without the flag the output is unchanged and the gate still passes at 96%.
no_single_gate_reason: The change adds a reporting flag to the eval runner itself; the runner's own gate (rank-1 floor plus 174 checks) is the verification, and the new flag is exercised by running it.
